nodes.description: Privileged owner address stored in BotProtected and used as access-control gate in DigiToken.
Address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract invoked by the checkBots modifier.
Uniswap V2 pair address computed in the constructor and passed to the bot-protection call.
Public mapping(address => uint) holding token balances of DigiToken.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding spend allowances.
Total token supply, initialized to 1e26 and used in list() payout math.
IUniswapV2Router02 router instance used by list() to add liquidity.
WETH token address used for pair computation.
Token name string 'Digi'.
Token symbol string 'DIGI'.
Constant token decimals set to 18.
Constructor of BotProtected that stores the bot-protection address.
Modifier performing a low-level external call to botProtection before running the guarded function body.
DigiToken constructor assigning owner = tx.origin and setting unlimited allowances and the uni pair.
ERC20 transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Guarded transfer that mutates allowances and balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Owner-gated function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with calldata b.
Pure helper computing the deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 formula.
Owner-only liquidity listing function that sets balances, calls addLiquidityETH with a timestamp deadline and loops over recipients.
Checked addition with overflow require.
Checked subtraction with underflow require.
Checked multiplication with overflow require.
Checked division with zero require.
Abstract ERC20 transfer that calls internal _transfer with msg.sender.
Abstract ERC20 transferFrom updating allowance through SafeMath.sub.
Internal balance-moving logic using SafeMath add/sub.
Internal allowance setter with zero-address checks.
Internal mint increasing total supply and balance.
Internal burn decreasing balance and total supply.
Caller-controlled address used as sender, spender and access-control subject.
Transaction origin used to assign privileged owner and to preset allowances in the constructor.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used to derive the addLiquidityETH deadline.
Arbitrary delegatecall to address a with calldata b inside delegate().
Low-level botProtection.call executed inside the checkBots modifier before state changes.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (Solidity 0.7, no SafeMath).
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
block.timestamp + 600 used as swap deadline in list().
External payable call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH during list().
Constructor parameter carrying the bot-protection contract address.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, also fed to checkBots.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom, also fed to checkBots.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, also fed to checkBots.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Amount of tokens placed in the contract and used for liquidity in list().
Array of recipient addresses in list().
Array of amounts assigned to recipients in list().
Target address of the delegatecall in delegate().
Calldata bytes forwarded to the delegatecall in delegate().
Boolean success flag returned by the botProtection low-level call.
Return-data bytes of the botProtection low-level call (unused).
Computed pair address returned by pairFor.
Loop index over the recipient arrays in list().

edges.reason: DigiToken constructor assigns owner from tx.origin, making the privileged owner the transaction origin.
tx.origin value flows into the owner state variable.
Constructor stores the pair returned by pairFor into uniPair.
Constructor invokes pairFor to compute the pair address.
Constructor presets unlimited allowances for itself and the router.
delegate() gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
delegate() performs an unrestricted delegatecall.
User-supplied address a is used directly as the delegatecall target.
User-supplied calldata b is forwarded verbatim to the delegatecall.
transferFrom is wrapped by the checkBots modifier which runs before the body.
checkBots makes a low-level external call before the guarded function body executes.
botProtection address is the target of the low-level call.
uniPair is forwarded as call data to the bot-protection contract.
notABot receives the boolean result of the external call.
isNotBot receives the return-data bytes of the external call.
The external call in the modifier can re-enter transferFrom before any balance or allowance state is updated.
msg.sender is used to validate and decrement the caller allowance.
_from indexes the balance mapping being debited.
_to indexes the balance mapping being credited.
_value is the amount moved and checked against allowance and balance.
_from selects the balance entry reduced without underflow protection.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] with a raw -= operator.
_to selects the balance entry increased without overflow protection.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] with a raw += operator.
transferFrom executes an unchecked balance subtraction on Solidity 0.7.
transferFrom executes an unchecked balance addition on Solidity 0.7.
transferFrom executes an unchecked allowance subtraction.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping that is decremented without SafeMath.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transfer forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transfer passes msg.sender as the source address.
approve writes allowance for msg.sender.
_spender is used as the allowance key in approve.
approve writes to the allowance mapping.
list() requires msg.sender == owner before minting/listing balances.
list() reads block.timestamp to build the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is added to 600 producing a miner-influenceable deadline.
list() computes the router deadline from the block timestamp.
list() calls uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with value msg.value.
The external router call occurs before the recipient balance loop, allowing re-entrancy into list()/transfer paths.
list() loops over recipient arrays using index i.
list() overwrites entries of the balanceOf mapping.
_numList sets the contract balance and the liquidity token amount.
_tos supplies the recipient addresses in the loop.
_amounts supplies the balances assigned in the loop.
Length of _tos bounds the index i.
Loop index writes balanceOf[_tos[i]] and emits a Transfer.
BotProtected constructor receives _botProtection.
_botProtection is written into the botProtection state variable.
pairFor computes and returns the pair local variable.
The returned pair value is assigned to uniPair in the DigiToken constructor.
ERC20.transfer calls the internal _transfer helper.
ERC20.transferFrom calls the internal _transfer helper.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
_transfer uses SafeMath subtraction for checked balance updates.
_burn uses SafeMath subtraction for balance and supply reduction.
_mint uses SafeMath addition for supply and balance increase.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter only carries the bot-protection address into state and has no independent behavior.
Source address parameter is only meaningful as the balance/allowance key inside transferFrom.
Destination address parameter is only used to credit balanceOf inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter drives the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
Spender parameter is only used as the allowance mapping key in approve.
Liquidity token amount parameter is consumed only by list() to set balances and call the router.
Recipient array parameter is only iterated inside list().
Amount array parameter is only assigned to balanceOf inside the list() loop.
Target address parameter flows directly into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Calldata parameter flows directly into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Local boolean result of the low-level call is only used inside the modifier's require.
Local return-data buffer is unused and scoped only to the modifier.
Local pair value is the sole return artifact of the pairFor helper.
Loop index is local to the recipient iteration in list().
